results.name: opens in drawing mode with the hint (zh)
a line under 25 m is refused with a message and drawing starts again
releasing turns the line into a track (ready) and writes the share code to #t=…
the drawn 24 m loop survives smoothing as a loop of about the same width (24 m); re-encoding the decoded track gives the same code
the same track simulated 10 times gives exactly the same ride (fixed 1/240 s steps)
the train goes upside down in the loop and gets through to the end station
Enter starts the ride: the train waits 2.2 s in the station, then leaves; first-person 3D with the minimap
3D view renders sky and ground (non-blank, different colours top and bottom)
M hides the minimap and remembers it; V switches to the side view
the end screen shows length, top speed, max G and airtime with ride again / draw new / save / copy / share on X
results.info: 到站了！  這條軌道的紀錄  全長 190m 最高速度 83km/h 最大 G 力 7.8G 騰空時間 1.7s 再搭一次 畫新的 存圖 複製連結 分享到 X

results.name: save image produces a PNG download
at the top of a loop the seat is upside down: the 3D view shows the ground at the top of the screen
a line longer than 1,500 m is kept whole (no length limit) and becomes a track
a 5821 m track with many loops rides to the end; the 3D track stays light (light mesh for far parts, a few full-detail chunks near the eye)
a shared link opens straight into the decoded track, fitted to the screen, with a banner (ja)
the same link opened 10 times: every ride is identical, and identical to the drawer’s
phone: a finger stroke becomes a track; no page scroll; buttons at least 44 px
